verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an auditor-approved policy template library, a policy editor with AI-assisted revisions, and personnel reminders for policy acceptance, which implies per-employee acceptance tracking. Policy versioning and approval workflows are not documented, and the templates are described as auditor-written rather than lawyer-grade. missing for 10: policy version history, policy approval workflow, explicit per-employee acceptance status reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, policies come from a lawyer-grade template library with an editor, versioning, approvals, and per-employee acceptance tracking

citations.quote: Save time writing policies from scratch with Secureframe's policy templates. Each template is written and approved by former auditors
Get policies set up quickly using our auditor-approved templates, tailor your policies using the comprehensive policy editor with AI-powered text revisions
Our policy editor allows you to create your own custom policies with the quick option to add attributes like company name, policy owner, and date modified.
Set up reminders for personnel to complete assigned tasks including policy acceptance and security awareness training completion
